about: Known mineral finds on the game's continents, in the game's own coordinates, the longitude and latitude its readout printed, in metres: one group per source, each find [longitude, latitude, item ids], two or more ids where the source cannot tell them apart or names several ores at a place. Written by petest's Tools/resourcesites.py; the scatter map's finds are its markers as placed by eye in the Archive editor's tools/scatteredit.py.

groups.name: Scatter map of mineral finds, placed by eye
groups.note: Each find is one marker of the picture, placed by eye at its centre, its mineral told by the legend's colour and shape; a marker is about 4 pixels, some 70 by 85 m, so a find's position is good to about 40 m. The placing is in progress: Zinc, Frigulite, Erdorium, Quantium, Ignisium, Durulium, Platinum have no markers placed yet.
